method: Local Go service with isolated headless Chromium and generated workbooks; bookmark confirmation also tested with two workbook identities.

checks: Eight widths and four pixel ratios: core commands, tabs, command search, workbook name and formula controls fit and receive pointer input without new source tasks
At 760 px 3 commands fold into the overflow menu and still run
The 320 px overflow font picker updates the grid and retains the selection; an idle ribbon queues no more layouts over 12 frames
Resizing the bar itself, independent of the window, recomputes overflow
Each of the five tabs shows exactly its own panel
Every tab command is registered in command search; eight open their dialogs; a command on another tab brings its tab forward and anchors its menu to the button
A column menu opened from command search while folded is anchored to its visible button; Escape closes it and restores focus
Ctrl+F1 folds the bar, a tab opens it over the sheet for one command, and the choice is remembered
Keyboard browsing beyond the first sixty entries selects and opens the eightieth worksheet

48 independent OOXML DPI/zoom/font combinations preserve exact source models, inherited row style, conditional display, Unicode rich runs, hidden rows, merged geometry and main/frozen numeric width decisions measured independently from computed fonts
DPR2 preview retains original source fonts and physical paper despite Consolas screen override and 125 percent grid zoom; 50/150/fit screen zoom changes no paper dimensions or print reads
12 native BIFF8 default-font boundary combinations use the shared main/frozen presenter without changing number/text types, source coordinates, formula caches or leading-zero identifiers
the actual UI saves committed predicates and natural sorting together with row heights, column widths, hidden columns, font, zoom, formula view and frozen panes
applying an unfiltered view restores all data and display controls; reapplying the saved view runs a fresh query whose complete natural row order and source coordinates match the saved rules
cancelling a late start reclaims its completed server result without replacing the active view; source validation failure also keeps the active filter and layout

updating keeps the applied query and complete layout; source-like view names render as text; reload retains the catalog without automatically running a saved query; deletion removes only its selected configuration
TXT sticky field headers are reconstructed from the actual saved source row; a view applied from another XLSX sheet returns to its bound sheet and preserves exact native numeric comparisons
